paragraphs: Search for people matching your filters and enrich their emails in a single async job. How it works: Submit search filters + max_contacts (how many contacts with emails you want, max 500 per call) Receive a task_id immediately Poll the GET endpoint with task_id for progress (with eta_seconds) and results For more than max_contacts, call again with the previous response's next_cursor Pricing: Search is free — you are never charged for people searched. basic: 1.5 credits per found email · premium: 5 credits per found email. You are charged ONLY for emails actually found. Worst-case credits are held up front (402 if insufficient). Deduplication: pass exclude_lists to skip people you already own — they are not enriched and not charged.

parameters.name: company_filters
parameters.description: Company filters to narrow down which companies to search people from. Use definition for semantic company search.

parameters.name: max_contacts
parameters.description: How many enriched contacts (found emails) you want. The search runs as wide as needed to reach this many found emails — you are charged ONLY for emails actually found, never for the search. Capped by your plan export limit.

parameters.name: people_filters
parameters.description: People filters used to find candidates: job_titles, geo, followers, etc.

parameters.name: company_linkedin_ids
parameters.description: Optional list of company LinkedIn IDs to restrict the search to these companies.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor. Omit for the first page; on later pages pass the next_cursor returned by the previous completed job (with the SAME filters/preset) to fetch the next batch.

parameters.name: exclude_lists
parameters.description: Ids of your dedup lists (see Deduplication endpoints). Results already present in these lists are excluded and never charged. When set, the free results zone does not apply. Max 100 lists / 500000 values combined per request.

parameters.name: preset
parameters.description: Quality preset: basic (1.5 credits per found email) or premium (5 credits per found email).
